usefulness.rationale: The dossier gives a coherent but thin picture: Fowler's Crop Trust executive directorship (2005–2012), his association with the Svalbard Global Seed Vault, and his 2024 World Food Prize. A reader learns the core of who he is, but notable anchors from the identity data — his US Special Envoy for Global Food Security role (2022–2025), his education, and his broader career — are absent, so understanding is partial rather than full. Nothing in the dossier flags what is missing or uncertain; it presents three facts without any statement of gaps, so remainingQuestions is low. For meeting preparation, the reader gets past roles and one honor but no current activity, no recent work, and no context on his policy positions — enough to recognize him, not enough to prepare a substantive conversation. All three dossier statements are directly supported by their cited Wikipedia passages: the executive directorship dates match both citations verbatim, 'known as the father of the Svalbard Global Seed Vault' is exactly what the source says (a reputation claim, not a construction claim, so it does not commit the 'vault-builder' error), and the World Food Prize selection is quoted with date and venue. No dossier statement overreaches its citation, so no overclaims are listed.
